statement.zh: Emery《Great Tombs of the First Dynasty》III（EES Memoir 47, 1958）正式报告萨卡拉第一王朝精英/超大型墓发掘成果。
statement.en: Emery’s Great Tombs of the First Dynasty III (EES Memoir 47, 1958) formally reports First Dynasty elite/great-tomb excavations at Saqqara.

editorial.notes: Density pass D-2026-10-11-22; fact claims cite registered sources only.
